verdict.rationale: Turso ships a scriptable CLI (turso db create/shell) and Platform API for programmatic, non-interactive database creation/teardown, plus SDKs (TS/Python/Rust/Go) and push/pull embedded replicas that work well in CI pipelines, and docs explicitly describe automating branch creation per PR — a clear CI/automation pattern. missing for 10: no explicit CI recipe/GitHub Actions example or independent report of headless CI usage confirming reliability at scale.
